FigmaBasics.1Frames.FramesinFi: Frames in Figma are what you may think of as artboards in other design tools. Frames are a foundational element for your designs that act as a top-level container for most things you create in Figma. There are a few different ways to create frames in Figma:
FigmaBasics.1Frames.CustomSizes.Customsi: Custom sizes\nCreate custom sized frames by selecting the frame tool and click and drag your cursor to the desired size.
FigmaBasics.1Frames.PresetSizes.Presetsi: Preset sizes\nCreate frames with preset sizes, e.g. iPhone X, by selecting the preset in the Properties panel on the right-hand side.
FigmaBasics.1Frames.ExistingElements.Exi: Existing elements\nCreate frames from existing elements on the canvas by right-clicking and selecting Frame Selection.
FigmaBasics.1Frames.SelecttheF: Select the Frame Tool              and click and drag along the dotted line to create a new frame.
TESTCHANGE2: Custom sizes\nCreate custom sized frames by selecting the frame tool and click and drag your cursor to the desired size.

FigmaBasics.4Styles.Colorstyles.Howtocre: How to create Color Styles\nSelect the object you’d like to create a Style for and in the Properties panel, click the Styles icon next to the property you would like to save. Click the “+” icon and you’ll be prompted to give your Style a name.
FigmaBasics.4Styles.Textstyles.Howtocrea: How to create Text Styles\nSelect the text you’d like to create a Style for and click the Style icon within the text properties in the Properties panel. Click the “+” icon and you’ll be prompted to give your Style a name.
FigmaBasics.4Styles.TheStylesf: The Styles feature allows you to define a set of properties like color, font, and effects of an object, that can be reused across your team\'s designs. Whenever you make a change to a Style’s properties, any objects using that Style will be instantly updated.
FigmaBasics.4Styles.1Createane: 1. Create a new Style\nSelect the text from the 1st chat bubble below and create a new Text Style from it. While you’re at it, also try creating a Color Style from the same text selection.
FigmaBasics.4Styles.2ApplyingS: 2. Applying Styles\nNotice how the 2nd and 3rd chat bubbles have different text and color? Try applying your newly created Text and Color Styles to them so they’re all consistent.
